title: Callichthyidae Dissection Protocol
author: Karina Carvalho F. Ferreira
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u3meyk6

steps.title: Make medial abdominal incision
steps.instruction: Make an incision in the medial portion of the abdomen immediately posterior to the pectoral girdle.

steps.title: Extend incision towards left flank
steps.instruction: Extend the opening from the medial incision towards the left flank in ventral view, using scissors, bypassing the pectoral girdle and proceeding to the dorsal side of the specimen up to the limit of the celomathic cavity.

steps.title: Lift skin and muscles
steps.instruction: Lift the ventral skin and muscles, holding the internal organs with thin‑point forceps, to fully expose the organs.

steps.title: Continue incision caudally
steps.instruction: Continue the incision in a caudal direction to the limit of the celomathic cavity, passing the pelvic girdle and ending immediately posterior to the pelvic girdle.

steps.title: Remove adipose tissue
steps.instruction: Remove adipose tissue with thin‑point forceps to improve visualization of internal organs.

steps.title: Release organs from peritoneum
steps.instruction: Release the organs from the peritoneum using the spacer.

steps.title: Cross-section esophagus
steps.instruction: Locate the esophagus and make a cross‑section on it using forceps and scissors.

substeps.instruction: Make a cross‑section on the esophagus using forceps and scissors

steps.title: Extract internal organs intact
steps.instruction: Remove the internal organs from the celomathic cavity without damaging them, preserving the shape and relative positions of each organ.

steps.title: Separate reproductive from digestive organs
steps.instruction: With the organs outside the celomathic cavity, separate the reproductive organs from the digestive system organs.

steps.title: Remove connective tissue and distend gut
steps.instruction: Remove connective tissue located between the intestinal walls and loops; then separate the intestinal walls and distend the digestive tube.

substeps.instruction: Remove connective tissue between intestinal walls and loops

steps.title: Disconnect intestine from anus
steps.instruction: Disconnect the intestine from the anus using forceps and scissors.
